typography.body: System sans stack (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif)
typography.headings: Same system sans stack; heavy weights (font-black/font-bold) rather than a separate display face.

component_patterns.header: White translucent sticky header with slate border/shadow; square black U mark; brand name 'U and Your Uni'; compact rounded-pill navigation; dark CTA.
component_patterns.hero: Light, airy sections using white/slate surfaces with selective pastel sky/amber/emerald/rose support colours; dark slate feature panels may be used as contrast.
component_patterns.buttons: Rounded-full dark slate primary CTAs on standard marketing pages; recruitment flow also uses amber-400 CTA on dark slate hero.
component_patterns.cards: Rounded-3xl pastel or white cards with fine slate borders and restrained shadow.
component_patterns.recruitment: Dark slate-950 hero, amber-400 highlight and CTA, stone-50 page background, white rounded-2xl application cards/forms.

visual_grammar.tone: Calm, independent, student-friendly, practical and modern.
visual_grammar.density: Airy but information-rich; clear pathway cards rather than decorative visual excess.
visual_grammar.icons: Lucide icons, typically slate with contextual accent colours.
visual_grammar.imagery: Supportive and credible student/university imagery where used; avoid glossy corporate stock or luxury styling.
visual_grammar.graphics: For mentor recruitment and social graphics, lead with slate/white, use sky or amber as a controlled accent, retain rounded friendly geometry and heavy sans headings. Pastel audience colours may support segmentation but should not overwhelm the composition.

invented gradients inconsistent with current site
